text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Labour minister starts a three-day visit to Britain to boost friendship and bilateral ties.
- Security forces in Bahrain arrested a group of saboteurs who set fire to a religious hall in Jidhafs area on July 11.
- Constructon of a $290 million sponge-iron plant will begin next year in Bahrain.
- Bahrain-based Arab Insurance Group acquired a majority share in a leading insurance company in Morocco in a transaction worth $27.7 million.
- Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company board of directors discussed plans to raise the firm's capital to four million dinars from a current two million dinars.
- Bahrain's ambassador to the United States said the island's dependence on oil decreased to 20 percent from 60 percent in the 1970s.
- Bahrain's transport minister reviewed with Yemeni transport undersecretary ways of boosting cooperation.
- Gulf Petrochemical Co posts a 18 million dinar operating income in the first half of 1997, up 55 percent from a year earlier.
